stem.text: Exactly $1.00\,\text{g}$ of a metallic element reacts completely with $300\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of oxygen at $298\,\text{K}$ and $1\,\text{atm}$ pressure to form an oxide which contains $\text{O}^{2-}$ ions.
The volume of one mole of gas at this temperature and pressure is $24.0\,\text{dm}^{3}$.
What could be the identity of the metal?
